This supersedes only the desired starter outcome of Issue123; no old count/root/acquisition/publication authority is reused.

scope.S141-1: Deliver an explicitly selected curated US-listed USD starter workflow with approximately 15–25 packaged candidate listings, verified listing identity and explicit duplicate-listing checks, source-backed current portfolio inputs, per-candidate exclusions, bounded shortlist and normal UI portfolio construction. Remove exhaustive curator Fund/class registry proof as a prerequisite of this distinct starter mode. Reuse existing collector, screening/construction/retrieval and review mechanisms where correct.
scope.S141-2: Document the narrower identity guarantee, retained older paths, scope supersession of Issue123 starter outcome, focused tests and one bounded real source feasibility/normal app demonstration in an isolated checkout. Preserve failed Issue123 and protected Issue117 evidence.

non_goals: Worldwide or EU expansion, legal Fund identity across all share classes, complete active-class inventories, continuity/succession registry, automatic saved-review migration, broad rollback, financial threshold weakening, trades, external financial writes, or retrying/renewing Issue123 operational authorities.

invariants.INV141-1: Distinct explicit starter selection. US-listed ETFs and USD only. Verified exact provider listing identity and directly supported conservative duplicate grouping; names, index or directory membership alone do not prove legal Fund equality. Missing or ambiguous supported identity blocks the candidate. State the narrower guarantee honestly; no invented ISIN or legal Fund certification.
invariants.INV141-2: Preserve existing financial category/threshold, source provenance and original observation freshness, holdings/concentration validation, exact monetary allocation, partial-evidence reporting and fail-closed restore/review safety. Unsupported candidates have explicit reasons.
invariants.INV141-3: Preserve legacy and already selected us-eu-v1/curator contracts and saved bytes/receipts. No marker stripping, silent downgrade or existing saved-review migration. New starter persistence/replay must bind its selected scope and candidate identities and validate offline.
invariants.INV141-4: Isolated new worktree and finite owner-led lifetime. Preserve Issue123 counts, root, failed attempts and blockers and all protected Issue117 edits. New live feasibility is only for the distinct starter contract after approved design; no registry/key/Issue123 publication operation. Bounded no-retry collection, safe source/error logs, no credentials/raw private data in git.

interfaces: Normal Streamlit/dashboard profile and research entry points; curated universe and source collector; identity/duplicate validation, snapshot/evidence/screening/shortlist/construction, checkpoint/restore and explanation. Architect must specify the smallest complete path. Provider/database boundaries remain replaceable.
capsule.json_state_impact: A new explicitly selected starter contract or equivalently unambiguous bounded versioned input may add bound curated-universe/listing/duplicate evidence to new snapshots, jobs and review state. JSON-serializable, exact offline validation; existing absent or selected markers and saved bytes retain semantics. Architect must specify exact representation before implementation.

acceptance.AC141-1: Normal app can select and research a packaged approximately 15–25 listing US/USD starter set without curator registry, and explain each requested/collected/screened/eligible/excluded/shortlisted/final count and candidate exclusion.
acceptance.AC141-2: Focused tests prove exact listing and duplicate constraints, unsupported/missing/stale/malformed inputs, defensive/growth coverage, shortlist construction and actual normal entry-point wiring. Existing financial controls remain enforced.
acceptance.AC141-3: New starter save/reload and offline restore preserve selected identity and decision, reject tampering/downgrade, and preserve legacy/us-eu/curator behavior and saved serialization.
acceptance.AC141-4: One bounded feasibility pass retains measured outcomes and provenance; demonstrate the normal app constructing an illustrative portfolio from actual supported expanded pool with equity and defensive coverage when sources support it. Report a specific source blocker if live evidence cannot meet this; offline fixtures alone cannot certify live readiness.
acceptance.AC141-5: Record design/handoff/ADR, scope supersession and operational use, run focused and required verification with identical-content independent review, commit/push/create PR.

verification: Focused pure and entry-point tests for starter collection, identity, per-candidate gaps, shortlist, portfolio construction, exact-money, serialization/replay and old-contract regression. Required repository lint/type/workflow gates and relevant full tests. One bounded live pass/demonstration only after source plan approval; source failure is reported truthfully.
documentation: New ADR for reduced US starter identity guarantee, active iteration and usage instructions, architecture/product scope update and explicit Issue123 supersession disposition with no grant or historical rewrite.
risks: Duplicate economic exposure confused with duplicate listings, starter marker downgrade, legacy replay change, incomplete holdings causing defensive-source failure, candidate expansion mistaken for live eligibility, or scope growth into general curation.
escalation_triggers: Consequential ambiguity returns to architect within finite allowance. Demonstrated implementation defect stays with owner and authorized remediation. High-risk financial/persistence change requires independent review. Failed live feasibility or review remains a blocker; no silent new attempt or allowance.
